evidence.observation: T tracks setpoint at 749-750 °C through growth, ramp followed profile closely
Pheat settled to a stable 44-46% during growth, consistent with normal control
Ar holds 99-101 sccm against 100 sccm setpoint
P steady ~760.7 Torr with no drift or excursion
Sensor not installed per manifest; telemetry null, so inert atmosphere/leak-tightness is unverifiable
Controller reports running throughout with values updating each event

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a substitute leak check, e.g. a pressure-decay/static-hold test with the installed gauge, or post-run inspection for oxidation) is needed to confirm the growth atmosphere was oxygen-free; installed sensors cannot rule out a seal leak.
